datasets.name: pricecmp1
queryLines:
WITH gold AS (
  SELECT * FROM gold_airbnb_valuation
), top_neighborhoods AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') AS neighborhood
  FROM gold
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT COALESCE(g.neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') AS neighborhood,
       'Actual' AS price_type, g.nightly_price AS nightly_price
FROM gold g JOIN top_neighborhoods n
  ON COALESCE(g.neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') = n.neighborhood
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(g.neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') AS neighborhood,
       'Predicted' AS price_type, g.predicted_nightly_price AS nightly_price
FROM gold g JOIN top_neighborhoods n
  ON COALESCE(g.neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') = n.neighborhood

datasets.name: errneigh1
queryLines:
SELECT COALESCE(neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') AS neighborhood,
       AVG(absolute_prediction_error) AS mean_absolute_error
FROM gold_airbnb_valuation
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY mean_absolute_error DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: toperror1
datasets.displayName: Listings with the largest prediction errors
queryLines:
SELECT listing_id, COALESCE(neighbourhood_cleansed, 'Unknown') AS neighborhood,
       nightly_price, predicted_nightly_price, absolute_prediction_error
FROM gold_airbnb_valuation
ORDER BY absolute_prediction_error DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: income01
datasets.displayName: Rental income under occupancy and expense scenarios
queryLines:
WITH scenarios AS (
  SELECT * FROM VALUES
    ('50% occ / 25% exp', 0.50, 0.25),
    ('50% occ / 35% exp', 0.50, 0.35),
    ('50% occ / 45% exp', 0.50, 0.45),
    ('65% occ / 25% exp', 0.65, 0.25),
    ('65% occ / 35% exp', 0.65, 0.35),
    ('65% occ / 45% exp', 0.65, 0.45),
    ('80% occ / 25% exp', 0.80, 0.25),
    ('80% occ / 35% exp', 0.80, 0.35),
    ('80% occ / 45% exp', 0.80, 0.45)
  AS s(scenario_name, occupancy_rate, expense_ratio)
), scenario_metrics AS (
  SELECT s.scenario_name, s.occupancy_rate, s.expense_ratio,
         AVG(g.predicted_nightly_price * 30 * s.occupancy_rate) AS monthly_gross_rent,
         AVG(g.predicted_nightly_price * 30 * s.occupancy_rate * (1 - s.expense_ratio)) AS monthly_noi
  FROM gold_airbnb_valuation g CROSS JOIN scenarios s
  GROUP BY s.scenario_name, s.occupancy_rate, s.expense_ratio
)
SELECT scenario_name, occupancy_rate, expense_ratio,
       'Gross monthly rent' AS income_type, monthly_gross_rent AS monthly_amount
FROM scenario_metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT scenario_name, occupancy_rate, expense_ratio,
       'After expenses (NOI)' AS income_type, monthly_noi AS monthly_amount
FROM scenario_metrics
